mapper.sql: id, user_id, session_id, question, answer, model_name, prompt_tokens, completion_tokens, total_tokens, cost, response_time, create_time, update_time, deleted
mapper.select: SELECT FROM ai_conversation WHERE session_id = #{sessionId} AND deleted = 0 ORDER BY create_time ASC
SELECT FROM ai_conversation WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND deleted = 0 ORDER BY create_time DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ai_conversation WHERE deleted = 0
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_conversation (id, user_id, session_id, question, answer, model_name, prompt_tokens, completion_tokens, total_tokens, cost, response_time, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{id}, #{userId}, #{sessionId}, #{question}, #{answer}, #{modelName}, #{promptTokens}, #{completionTokens}, #{totalTokens}, #{cost}, #{responseTime}, NOW(), NOW())
